rules.name: harbinger:workbench_success_seconds:p95_5m
rules.query: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (job, instance, route, le) (rate(harbinger_workbench_seconds_bucket{job="harbinger",outcome="success"}[10s])))

rules.name: HarbingerWorkbenchSlow
rules.query: (harbinger:workbench_success_seconds:p95_5m > 0.001) and on (job, instance, route) (harbinger:workbench_success:increase5m >= 1) and on (job, instance) (up{job="harbinger"} == 1)

annotations.summary: Workbench successful-request p95 exceeds 2 seconds with sufficient traffic

rules.name: HarbingerWorkbenchFailures
rules.query: (sum by (job, instance, route) (rate(harbinger_workbench_seconds_count{job="harbinger",outcome="failed"}[10s])) > 0) and on (job, instance) (up{job="harbinger"} == 1)

annotations.summary: Workbench requests are failing with server errors

rules.name: HarbingerWorkbenchCapacity
rules.query: (sum by (job, instance, route) (rate(harbinger_workbench_seconds_count{job="harbinger",outcome="rejected"}[10s])) > 0) and on (job, instance) (up{job="harbinger"} == 1)

annotations.summary: Workbench is intentionally rejecting requests with HTTP 429
